decisions.reason: As a lightly signaled 2019 addition in a more competitive dumper niche, it looks like a weaker option whose uncertain upside likely no longer justifies scarce engineering and sales attention versus the firm's stronger core lines.

A dedicated multi-model furniture-lift line fits the firm's lifting and transport capabilities well, and if demand is still somewhat uncertain the option value of keeping it available likely exceeds its relatively modest carrying cost.

The building-material lift line appears closely aligned with the firm's specialization in practical, safety-focused lifting equipment, so management would likely retain it while continuing to learn about market traction.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is somewhat more niche and costlier to support than the broader lift lines, but it is still adjacent to the firm's capabilities and worth keeping unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.
